title: Road Hi Galat Hai
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.
human_truth: Some couples do not resolve every wrong turn by finding who was right. They survive by choosing the same ridiculous villain.
reader_mirror: Anyone who has jointly blamed a flyover, Google Maps, or a service lane can send this.
emotional_arc: choice -> missed cut -> overconfident victory -> second choice -> shared blame -> time penalty receipt -> same-team payoff -> tag prompt
relationship_motion: Mutual/shared situation. Aachu is first right and expressive; the road then makes both of them equally ridiculous. The relationship turn is both pointing away from each other and toward the confusing road.
